steps.what: Find the current emergency preparedness plans, resource materials and source revisions in {DOCS}.
Compare current and revised emergency-plan resource materials in {DOCS}, locating changed passages and affected references.

loop.input: Current and revised source pages from s1
loop.output: Proposed change list with both source passages
loop.check: Director reads changed meaning, omissions, scope and exact source versions
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported or conflicting sources go to manual comparison
loop.why_not_simpler: Native text diff is used first, but revised narrative can move or restate the same obligation

steps.what: Verify actual resource availability, contacts and operational implications with responsible resource owners before deciding which material changes are valid.
outputs: Verified facts and director's update decisions

steps.what: Maintain and update all resource materials associated with emergency preparedness plans in {DOCS}, applying the verified decisions and current references.
inputs: Verified facts and decisions from s3

steps.what: Check the completed revised resource materials for operational meaning, completeness, verified availability, exact references and intended library audience.
outputs: Checked exact material set and audience

steps.what: Save the exact checked revised resource material version in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact material set checked in s5

steps.what: Publish the exact checked resource material version to the verified preparedness-library audience in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact saved checked version and audience

tasks.design: Configure versioned resource views and reusable references in {DOCS}, then use a bounded comparison only for narrative changes that native diff cannot explain. The director verifies real resources with owners, updates the material and checks the final version before saving and publishing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative revisions and references are compared and maintained across scattered resource files.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version views, linked fields and bounded source comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Whether listed resources will actually work in the relevant emergency.
tasks.human_edge: Operational judgment and verification with responsible owners.

ambition.what: No expansion of emergency authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less file comparison, with resource validity still the director's responsibility.

evidence.claim: Versioned libraries and source-linked narrative comparison can assist material maintenance while operational approval remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual resource-material revision cycle. Shares and reductions are conditional E1 design estimates, not observed baselines.

Existing source owners provide document id, version, date and source text. Director locates these in s1 and verifies resource identity, contact, availability and limits through actual work in s3. Missing fields or conflicting text require manual comparison; no free resource-validity feed is presumed.

Native version history and diff are tested before the bounded loop. Native field reuse in s4 only reduces repeated references and formatting; new operating meaning remains human. No source-owner labour is reduced or transferred into the claimed saving.

The ordinary completed-material check supplies the requested action gates without added self-approval labour. Every change voids approval. Same-system saves and publication retain their real short time; existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Can a source comparison preserve moved passages and operational exceptions without inventing a change?

already_counted.description: Residual retrieval and comparison, owner verification, updates, full final check and action tails remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and sample comparison omissions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed material set checked in s5
Same exact checked material version and audience from s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 40% retrieval + 25 x 50% comparison + 23 x 20% reference-format reuse = 25.1 gross less 2 upkeep. Native-organised sources may yield no benefit; operational work and saves retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare disaster response and recovery plans

steps.what: Review actual hazards, existing emergency plans and applicable national requirements in {DOCS} for the organisation's response and recovery scope.
Work through actual response dependencies, available resources and recovery responsibilities with relevant organisational and external contacts.
outputs: Actual planning constraints and agreed contributions

steps.what: Determine the actual response and recovery operating procedures, decision boundaries and unresolved hazards for the plan.
Prepare plans that outline operating procedures to be used in response to disasters or emergencies and in recovery from these events in {DOCS}, expressing the actual procedure design.
outputs: Completed response and recovery plan draft

loop.purpose: Express the director's existing procedure design as a plan draft
loop.input: Verified sources and actual procedure design from s3
loop.output: Source-linked response and recovery plan draft with unresolved gaps flagged
loop.check: Director checks all responsibilities, triggers, dependencies, exceptions and recovery meaning against s3 and sources
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved design or unsupported instructions remain manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle headings, but prose must express the actual contextual design without changing it

steps.what: Complete necessary corrections and check the final plan's operational meaning, constraints, actual responsibilities and intended distribution under existing approval arrangements.
outputs: Checked exact final plan and audience

steps.what: Save the exact checked final response and recovery plan in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact final plan checked in s5

steps.what: Publish the exact checked final plan to its verified internal preparedness audience in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact saved final plan and checked audience

tasks.design: Use native planning-source views and plan templates in {DOCS} first. A bounded loop drafts prose from the director's actual procedure design, leaving planning decisions and final operational checks human before separate save and publication actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing contextual procedure design in a consistent document takes repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates with source-linked bounded prose drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Safe response design and realistic recovery dependencies.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable planning with real operational stakeholders.

ambition.what: No automated emergency-command service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less transcription of a completed design; decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: A bounded model can help express a source-grounded human procedure design without becoming the emergency decision maker.

assumptions: Boundary includes source work, consultation, substantive plan design, actual drafting and internal publication in an organisation where the director has the stated authority. Shares are E1 conditional estimates.

Existing document owners provide plan and requirement source text with version and scope. Director reads sources in s1, obtains actual constraints in s2 and produces actual procedure content in s3. Missing facts stay unresolved for manual work rather than being invented by the drafting loop.

Test native retrieval and templates first. No outside participant labour is saved, no meeting transcript is free and no operating procedure is selected by the model. No existing runtime or save-tail saving is claimed.

The final completed-plan check in s5 occurs after all corrections. Any subsequent correction voids action gates. Required higher-authority approval must be obtained under existing arrangements before publication; its separate labour is not credited as saved.
research_questions: Does bounded prose drafting preserve every response trigger, responsibility and recovery condition from the human design?

already_counted.description: Source reading, real consultation, design, residual drafting, final corrections and separate actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source links and audit draft fidelity after template or source changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected final plan checked in s5
Same exact corrected final plan and audience checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 25% source retrieval + 25 x 35% drafting = 13.75 gross less 2 upkeep. Existing efficient templates may yield zero; no design, consultation or publication saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop tests and evaluation criteria for actual emergency management plans, reading applicable national requirements and selecting realistic exercise scope.
inputs: Actual requirements and available exercise context
outputs: Actual exercise design and evaluation criteria

steps.what: Write the actual exercise instructions, observation forms and criteria in {DOCS} from the completed exercise design.
inputs: Actual design and criteria from s1

steps.what: Check the completed exercise pack, actual participants, exercise boundaries and readiness under existing exercise controls before proceeding.
Perform the actual tests of emergency management plans and observe the real response within the checked exercise boundaries.
Record actual exercise observations, event times, criterion identity and evidence in the working {SPREADSHEET} as the test occurs.
inputs: Actual observed exercise events from s4

steps.what: Compile the captured exercise evidence rows into criterion-level counts and elapsed-time summaries in the working {SPREADSHEET}.
Reconcile the summaries to actual observations and evaluate emergency-plan performance, limitations and required improvements rather than equating counts with effectiveness.
outputs: Verified evidence and actual evaluation conclusions

steps.what: Write and check the completed exercise evaluation report in {DOCS}, including actual conclusions, evidence, limitations and intended recipients.
outputs: Checked exact evaluation report and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked evaluation report in {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked evaluation report to verified external exercise partners through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact report and recipients checked in s8

tasks.design: Configure native forms and summary formulas in {SPREADSHEET} and reusable exercise/report fields in {DOCS}. The director designs and performs the real test, captures its evidence and evaluates the result; software only compiles the actual rows and reuses headings and verified fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exercise evidence is manually tallied into criterion summaries.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables, fixed formulas and linked report fields.
tasks.still_hard: A realistic safe test and valid interpretation of observed performance.
tasks.human_edge: Exercise judgment and explaining what the test did not establish.

ambition.what: No larger exercise programme is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less manual compilation; test authority and evaluation remain human.

reach.learn: Evidence criteria and operational exercise boundaries

evidence.claim: Configured tables and formulas can compile actual exercise evidence without judging emergency-plan effectiveness.

assumptions: Boundary is one actual exercise with an existing evaluation and external partner report. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured exercise baselines. Applicable national requirements replace US-specific wording.

Director produces criteria and exercise content in s1-s2 and actual evidence in s4-s5. Evidence fields are criterion id, event id, actual time, observation and source reference. Missing time or ambiguous criteria require manual reconciliation in s7; no participant performance is inferred from attendance or calendar end.

Native formulas are tested before custom code. s6 changes actual manual compilation only and leaves capture fully counted. s2 and s8 reduce only recurring headings and verified field placement; new instructions, conclusions and meaning checks remain human. Existing automatic calculation runtime gives zero saving.

The exercise gate uses existing readiness controls, not added bureaucracy. Report gates bind the final completed version after corrections; edits void them. Saves and sends keep their actual short time. Participant labour is unchanged outside this focal-role denominator.
research_questions: Can native summaries reproduce every criterion count and elapsed interval while marking missing evidence explicitly?

already_counted.description: Actual design, pack review, readiness, exercise, capture, evaluation, report review and action tails remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain criteria mappings, formulas and report field links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact exercise pack, boundaries and actual readiness checked in s3
Exact final evaluation report checked in s8
Same exact final evaluation report and recipients checked in s8

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 8 x 20% pack field reuse + 10 manual compilation + 7 x 20% report field reuse = 13 gross less 1.5 upkeep. Already compiled evidence yields no benefit; actual exercise and judgment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collaborate with other officials to prepare and analyze damage assessments following disasters or emergencies, clarifying actual reports, coverage and conflicting accounts.
outputs: Actual assessment scope, report set and unresolved questions

steps.what: Examine actual available damage evidence and conditions within the director's authorised assessment role, identifying limits and contradictory information.
inputs: Actual assessment scope and available evidence
outputs: Director's actual observations and evidence limits

steps.what: Capture the actual location, observation time, damage description and evidence reference in the working assessment file {DOCS}.
Consolidate actual report passages and captured observations in {DOCS}, marking possible duplicate damage accounts and conflicting evidence with source links.

loop.purpose: Propose a traceable consolidation of actual damage accounts
loop.input: Actual report passages and director's captured observations
loop.output: Draft source-linked account table with possible duplicates and conflicts flagged
loop.check: Director checks actual location, time, described damage, source meaning and all proposed duplicate links
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; uncertain matches remain separate for human assessment
loop.why_not_simpler: Native exact-id matching is used first, but damage narratives describe the same event differently

steps.what: Verify the consolidated evidence and judge actual damage significance, uncertainty and unresolved assessment needs with the available sources.
outputs: Verified assessment conclusions and explicit uncertainties

steps.what: Write and check the final damage assessment in {DOCS}, including actual conclusions, source references, uncertainty and authorised recipients.
outputs: Checked exact damage assessment and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked final damage assessment in {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked damage assessment to the verified external officials through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact assessment and recipients checked in s6

tasks.design: Use native source identifiers and report fields in {DOCS} before bounded narrative consolidation. The director retains actual collaboration, observation and damage judgment, checks every proposed duplicate against its source and reviews the completed assessment before separate save and send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Officials' narrative damage reports require repeated source comparison and consolidation.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked bounded extraction beside native identifiers and reusable report fields.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete evidence, changing conditions and the significance of actual damage.
tasks.human_edge: Collaboration and accountable interpretation of uncertain observations.

ambition.what: No automated damage valuation or emergency action is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less evidence assembly, with assessment authority unchanged.

reach.task: Assess operational damage and continuity effects

evidence.claim: A bounded extraction can propose source-linked consolidation of damage narratives while uncertain matches and assessment stay human.

assumptions: Boundary is the director's actual contribution, capture, analysis, written assessment and external handoff. Shares are conditional E1 estimates, not measured disaster-response baselines. Other officials' original reports are existing inputs and their labour is unchanged, not saved or newly transferred.

Director obtains actual reports in s1, examines evidence in s2 and captures location, actual observation time, description, source identity and limitations in s3. Missing fields require manual original-source checks in s5; no structured damage score or free sensor feed is assumed.

Test native report-id matching and templates before model use. s4 proposes rather than deletes duplicates. s6 only reduces field/reference placement; actual conclusions and final meaning checks remain human. No building-safety certification, compensation decision or emergency dispatch is automated.

The ordinary completed-assessment check supplies exact-version gates after corrections, with no added approval stage. Changes void the gates. Same-system save and send retain their real short time; no existing-runtime saving.
research_questions: Can narrative consolidation preserve distinct damage events and uncertainty while reducing actual manual comparison?

already_counted.description: Actual collaboration, observation, capture, residual consolidation, judgment, report review and action tails remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and audit false duplicate proposals.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final assessment checked in s6
Same exact final assessment and authorised recipients checked in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 50% consolidation + 8 x 20% field placement = 11.6 gross less 1.5 upkeep. Non-overlapping reports or poor sources may yield no benefit; actual collaboration and judgment retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Operational design, exercise judgment and damage assessment remain with the director.
role.ambitious_version: A director who spends less time assembling documents and retains direct responsibility for realistic plans, exercises and uncertain disaster evidence.
